primary_references.facts: YCB-V has public RGB-D/object pose metadata including K, poses and depth factor; 21 objects, separate from pallet semantic/native labels.
BOP provides real and PBR training data and warns original YCB-V 80k synthetic images share test poses. BOP models/poses use transformed mm coordinates.

BOP per-scene GT/camera, depth, object/full and visible masks can support a separately declared point/part teacher with explicit unknown/SELF handling. Masks alone are not native pallet keypoint gold.

source_to_pallet_transfer: Inference: usable for generic occlusion supervision, not automatic proof of target-pallet/native semantics. Public SOURCE teacher must distinguish query ownership, self visibility and external obstruction.
